B1 Second Interview - Zfat
Hey everyone,

We had our second B1 interview, in Zfat due to moving up North.

We sent the documents 3 months in advance and they sent us what’s missing.

In our experience the People from the Office were well available on Mail, and we got an Appointment on the 16.8., one week ago we got an Email that our Appointment can already happen on the 2.8. once we were answering back they changed it to today.

We arrived a bit early and the Clerk was explaining to us that they are a small branch that is available by Mail, and if there is anything we don’t understand we can always ask. 

They told us that once we apply next time we should write 4 months before the visa is running out an email and they will send us all the documents they need from us.

The Clerk was very friendly and tried to take the stress away…

First they were asking my Partner the Questions and I was filling out the Document AS3

These are the questions we got asked:

- Names of Familymembers, if they are married, where they live, what they work, names of children if there are

- Things about daily life:

—> where do you live, how do you pay for the Appartement, how much is the cost, what does your partner do in life, hours he is working, how many times he‘s working per week, how are you going to work, how are you getting along with one car (same questions for myself)

- Things about today:

—> how did you get here, did you stop on the way, did you eat, did you drink something, if so what, will you work later on, if so when, what other things have you planned for today.

After the Interview we asked the clerk about the changes in the Process, and if there is a possibility to get a two year visa on B1. She said that she thinks it’s only for A5 but that there was something in discussion so she checked it for us and was saying that it‘s possible and gave us the visa for 2 years.
